name: Unarmored Defense
description: While not wearing armor, AC = 10 + Dex modifier + Con modifier. A shield can still be used.

name: Rage
description: Bonus action: resistance to Bludgeoning/Piercing/Slashing damage and extra melee damage for 1 minute. Uses scale with level.

name: Reckless Attack
description: On your turn, gain Advantage on Strength-based attack rolls this turn, but attacks against you have Advantage until your next turn.

name: Danger Sense
description: Advantage on Dexterity saving throws against effects you can see, as long as you aren't Blinded, Deafened, or Incapacitated.

name: Extra Attack
description: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

name: Bardic Inspiration
description: Bonus action: give a creature a Bardic Inspiration die (d6, scaling with level) to add to one ability check, attack roll, or save.

name: Jack of All Trades
description: Add half your Proficiency Bonus (round down) to any ability check that doesn't already include your Proficiency Bonus.

name: Expertise
description: Choose two skill proficiencies (or one skill and Thieves' Tools) to become an Expertise — use the skill row's proficiency dot to mark it.

name: Divine Order
description: Choose Protector (Martial weapon and Heavy armor training) or Thaumaturge (extra cantrip, Wisdom to Arcana/Religion checks).

name: Channel Divinity
description: Fuel domain and cleric features that consume a Channel Divinity use; uses scale with level.

name: Wild Shape
description: Action: magically transform into a beast form you've learned, for a number of hours based on level.

name: Druidic
description: You know Druidic, the secret language of druids, and can leave hidden messages other druids will automatically spot.

name: Second Wind
description: Bonus action: regain 1d10 + Fighter level hit points.

name: Action Surge
description: Take one additional action on your turn, on top of your regular action and a possible bonus action.

name: Extra Attack
description: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

name: Martial Arts
description: Use Dexterity instead of Strength for unarmed strikes and Monk weapons; unarmed strike damage die scales with level.

name: Unarmored Defense
description: While not wearing armor or a shield, AC = 10 + Dex modifier + Wis modifier.

name: Focus Points
description: Spend points fueling Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense, Step of the Wind, and other Monk features. Pool equals your Monk level.

name: Lay on Hands
description: A healing pool (5 × Paladin level) you can spend as an action, 1 point restoring 1 HP to a touched creature.

name: Channel Divinity
description: Fuel your Sacred Oath's Channel Divinity options.

name: Extra Attack
description: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

name: Deft Explorer
description: Gain an Expertise skill, and a bonus to Initiative and one Origin-related benefit reflecting your travels.

name: Extra Attack
description: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

name: Expertise
description: Choose two of your skill proficiencies (or one skill and Thieves' Tools) to become an Expertise.

name: Sneak Attack
description: Once per turn, deal extra damage (scaling with level) on one attack with a Finesse or ranged weapon if you have Advantage, or an ally is within 5 feet of the target.

name: Cunning Action
description: Bonus action: Dash, Disengage, or Hide.

name: Sorcery Points
description: A pool (equal to Sorcerer level) you can convert to and from spell slots, and spend on Metamagic options.

name: Innate Sorcery
description: Bonus action: your spell attacks have Advantage and your spell save DC increases by 1, for 1 minute.

name: Pact Magic
description: Your spell slots are few but recharge on a Short or Long Rest, unlike other casters. Tracked in the Spells tab.

name: Eldritch Invocations
description: You learn magical shortcuts called Invocations that customize your warlock powers; track chosen invocations in Notes for now.

name: Arcane Recovery
description: Once per day after a Short Rest, recover expended spell slots with a combined level up to half your Wizard level (rounded up).

name: Ritual Casting
description: Cast a Wizard spell with the Ritual tag as a ritual, without expending a spell slot, if it's in your spellbook.
